sources.summary: Codex supports ChatGPT subscription and API-key authentication. Programmatic CLI workflows default toward API keys; Enterprise access tokens form a separate trusted automation option.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: codex exec provides non-interactive operation and reuses saved CLI authentication. The advanced account-auth CI path has specific trusted/private-runner limitations.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: The official SDK supports programmatic local Codex agents and application integration; custom clients use the app server.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: Claude Code documents subscription sign-in, Console and supported inference-provider routes.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: claude -p/--print supports scripted operation and structured output. Bare mode excludes subscription OAuth and uses API/provider authentication.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: Products can run the unmodified Claude Code binary subject to commercial terms, preserved authentication and each user paying/authenticating directly. Third-party apps must not collect or intermediate Claude.ai credentials or offer their own Claude.ai login; end users can sign in through the unmodified binary.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: Gemini CLI documents Google-account login, including associated Pro/Ultra subscriptions, API keys and Vertex AI. Headless mode can reuse cached authentication; without it an API/Vertex configuration is required.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: Gemini CLI documents non-interactive prompt execution and structured output.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: Applicable terms vary by authentication route. Direct third-party access to Gemini CLI backing services using its OAuth is expressly prohibited. Official CLI orchestration requires a separate scope review.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review

sources.summary: V2 supports provider-specific key/OAuth/command/environment methods. Credentials belong to the CLI-managed SQLite store; legacy auth.json instructions do not describe current V2 storage. Shared-service environment changes can restart the service.
sources.scope: documentation observation; policy applicability requires route review
